evidence: Carries the Mining label, modifies BlockTemplateManager in src/node/block_template_manager.{h,cpp}, and extends interfaces::Mining.
rationale: Adds template memory footprint tracking and a `getMemoryLoad()` IPC method to prevent unmonitored memory growth from templates pinning evicted transactions. This directly serves external Stratum v2 template providers (stratum-mining/sv2-tp#63) addressing issue #33899, providing essential resource tracking for external mining clients.
